content_sections.heading: DMU Lab Cum Field Attendant Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About DMU
content_sections.text: Dhanamanjuri University (DMU) is a university in Manipur, and this notice comes from its Department of Zoology. The post serves a project on a Live Fish Genebank and Community Aquaculture Centre at Chakpikarong, Chandel District, Manipur, with Dr BD Shangningam Anal as Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: DMU Lab Cum Field Attendant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Candidate should have completed 10+2 in Agriculture/Science/Arts/Commerce. Desirable qualification: Working experience in the field of Fishery science. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview held in the university's Department of Zoology.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment will be for five (05) months, extendable based on satisfactory performance and project requirements. The selected candidate shall not have any claim for regular appointment in the University or under ICAR.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMU Lab Cum Field Attendant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Collect your original certificates and documents. Go to the Department of Zoology, Dhanamanjuri University, Manipur - 795001, for the interview at the date and time given above. Produce the original certificates and documents at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. Can a 10+2 Arts or Commerce candidate attend?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice accepts 10+2 in Agriculture, Science, Arts or Commerce.

faq.question: Q2. Is experience in fisheries compulsory?
faq.answer: No. Working experience in the field of Fishery science is listed as desirable, not essential.

faq.question: Q3. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: The first appointment is for five months. It can be extended based on satisfactory performance and project requirements.

faq.question: Q4. Will travel costs for the interview be paid?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q5. Who funds the project?
faq.answer: The ICAR-National Bureau of Fish Genetic Resources, Lucknow, funds the project.

faq.question: Q6. Whom can candidates contact about this post?
faq.answer: The notice gives the contact number of the Principal Investigator in the Department of Zoology: +919612303652.
